chapter: Maple Leaf, own orchestra and rivals
title: The radio offer and what became of his horns
summary: Mr. Bienvenue planned to put his band on WSMB but he fell ill; he sold his old horns.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: You wanted to tell us about the radio too, and we were talking about that when the machine was on. What happened?
On television? I mean on the radio.

Oh yeah, that's Mr. Bienvenue from the New Orleans Country Club. He was going to put me over there, the first one was going on the app in New Orleans, WSMB. But I got sick, that's the time I got sick. I was working for New Orleans Country Club. I had my horn band. I got my little sign yet that I used to put in front of music stands.

Is there any possibility that these instruments that you had could be located? Did you give them to someone in your family? Do you know where any of these instruments are that you use now? The horns? No, no, I haven't got any.

You sold them all? No, I didn't have but one. Because when I changed I bought a new one, you see. And you just sold them, right? Yeah, because you see for instance I was going to change this instrument or give it as part payment or something like that. Oh yeah. I always got rid of them. I was careful.
